tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 3rd house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 3rd house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered in this part of life. You refuse to be silenced; your voice and daily thinking will not be policed. Buried intensity finds an outlet in writing and communication; thinking runs deep and unconventional. Putting the undercurrent into words is part of the reclamation. The source also links this placement to a significant early event or focus involving a sibling, which can leave a lasting imprint and calls for honest self-exploration.
business: The disowned self activates through voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication. Says the unsayable and thinks for itself.
shadow: A sharp, alienating tongue, or swallowed words that turn bitter.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 3rd house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with voice, thought, siblings, neighbors, learning, and daily communication directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
